title.zh: OpenAI发布AI科学突破论文引发争议
title.en: OpenAI's AI scientific-breakthrough claims draw scrutiny

current_state.zh: OpenAI发布了一篇67页的论文，声称其AI找到了绕过1999年指数时间假说的方法，引发了科学界的审视，也让误把“ETH”当作以太坊的加密交易者感到困惑。
current_state.en: OpenAI published a 67-page paper claiming its AI found a way around the 1999 Exponential Time Hypothesis, prompting both scientific scrutiny and confused reactions from crypto traders who mistook 'ETH' for Ethereum.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI宣布AI取得三项科学突破，涉及数学猜想、计算机算法及千禧年难题
updates.title_en: OpenAI宣布AI取得三项科学突破，涉及数学猜想、计算机算法及千禧年难题
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 宣布其 AI 模型独立证明了重大数学猜想（包括 Kakeya 和 Stein 限制），推翻了计算机科学中的指数时间假说，并给出了与量子色动力学和杨–米尔斯理论相关的严格存在性证明，其中数学和计算机科学结果已在 Lean 中形式化，物理学主张仍在专家评审中。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI announced that its AI models independently proved major mathematical conjectures (including Kakeya and Stein restriction), overturned the exponential time hypothesis in computer science, and produced strict existence proofs tied to quantum chromodynamics and Yang–Mills theory, with the math and CS results formalized in Lean and the physics claims still under expert review.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI宣布破解ETH？但这个ETH指的是计算机领域重要猜想「指数时间假设」
updates.title_en: OpenAI宣布破解ETH？但这个ETH指的是计算机领域重要猜想「指数时间假设」
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 称其 AI 模型找到了精确计数 k-SAT 解的确定性次指数时间算法，并已在 Lean 中验证，这一结果将直接挑战计算复杂性理论中已有 25 年历史的指数时间假说。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI claims its AI model found a deterministic subexponential-time algorithm for exactly counting k-SAT solutions, verified in Lean, a result that would directly challenge the 25-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis in computational complexity theory.
